checks.name: release authority
checks.evidence: Package and native shell declare the current 4.0.0 authority.

checks.name: transactional universal object creation
checks.evidence: All required types share one factory, selection update, and undo transaction.

checks.name: searchable grouped palettes
checks.evidence: Create Object and Add Component expose grouping, search, compatibility, dependencies, favorites, and recents.

checks.name: complete viewport tool and snapping surface
checks.evidence: Gizmos, ruler, arrangement, isolation, grouping, and seven snapping modes are reachable in Design.

checks.name: non-overlapping responsive toolbar
checks.evidence: Toolbar controls keep intrinsic width, center when space permits, and scroll only when the viewport is genuinely narrower than the tool set.

checks.name: camera authoring and overlays
checks.evidence: Camera edit, persistence, preview, pixel-perfect, and common resolution overlays are connected.

checks.name: origin canvas and parallax controls
checks.evidence: Origin, canvas-space, camera-follow, motion-scale, and repeat controls are exposed and connected to rendering.

checks.name: inspector metadata and property transactions
checks.evidence: Inspector actions, validation metadata, pinned/modified views, and undo recording are implemented.

checks.name: multi-edit preserves mixed properties
checks.evidence: Multi-edit only writes the explicitly selected shared property.

checks.name: component lifecycle workflow
checks.evidence: Components can be enabled, disabled, copied, pasted, reordered, reset, and removed.

checks.name: sprite and image workflow
checks.evidence: Slicing, atlas region, trim, pivots, borders/nine-slice, import settings, and one-step viewport drop are present.

checks.name: hierarchy productivity and transform modes
checks.evidence: Search, breadcrumb, status, world/local reparent, reorder, and transactions are implemented.

checks.name: large-scene rendering mode and unobtrusive outlines
checks.evidence: Performance culling and pixel-art-aware selection treatment are implemented.

checks.name: path preservation and scene round trip
checks.evidence: Open paths are not convex-hulled and all authoring metadata is serialized and normalized.

checks.name: localized authoring interface
checks.evidence: English, German, and Simplified Chinese authoring controls are available.
